bio.text: David C. "Dave" Graham is the Republican candidate for Delaware Attorney General in 2026, nominated by the Delaware Republican Party in August 2026.

Delaware LIVE describes Graham as a U.S. Army and Delaware National Guard veteran who has worked for the Delaware Department of Finance since 2003 and previously spent about 25 years as a certified public accountant.
Graham ran as a write-in candidate for governor in 2012, as the Independent Party candidate for attorney general in 2014, and sought the Republican nomination for governor in 2020.

sources.title: DEGOP names veteran Dave Graham as attorney general candidate
